<!-- wuwa-mac-minimum: 13.0 -->

## Changelog

- Rendered update notes as Markdown, including headings, lists, emphasis, code, tables and browser links, using the app's existing styling.
- Changed both regional bundle IDs to the `io.github.kyrie25` namespace and added first-launch migration of counters, shortcuts, WebKit settings and remembered login from the matching old identity.
- Added persistent self-signed app signing so future updates retain the same regional Keychain identity. Release CI verifies access across different binaries and rejects ad-hoc or cross-region replacements.
- Added explicit credit and a link to the [original macOS port](https://github.com/Last-emo-boy/wuwa-tappo-mac) in the README while retaining its license notices.

## Instructions

- Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 13 or later. Choose the package matching your CN or Global account.
- From mac.5 or later, use **Settings → Check for Updates → Update and Restart**. Markdown rendering becomes available after installing this version.
- For manual installation, quit all older copies and replace the existing app with `Wuwa Tappo.app` from the matching DMG or ZIP.
- The first launch under the new bundle ID imports existing regional data. macOS may request authorization to read your previous Keychain login; use **Always Allow** if offered to remember authorization. Original data is retained for recovery. Later releases keep the same signing identity; locked Keychains or changed access policies can still require authorization.
- Self-signing does not provide Apple notarization or Gatekeeper trust. If macOS blocks launch, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**.
- Both packages contain `Wuwa Tappo.app`; use separate folders to keep both regions. `.app.tar.gz` and `.sig` files are for the in-app updater.
